speaker: diane_sterling
headline: VALUE LEAKS AT EVERY HANDOFF.
deck: The economic test is whether public capital survives the chain from authorisation to a usable service without delay, inflation or execution failure.
quote: Track the conversion rate from money approved to value delivered.
facts: Each handoff adds time, cost and execution risk.
Contract clarity reduces expensive rework and dispute.
Operational readiness matters before an asset can perform.
The final service is the only output households can consume.
takeaway: Performance is the share of public capital that survives every handoff and reaches a usable outcome.
